# Set up R & RStudio {.hero #s00c-installation}

::: {.section-badge}
Setup · Install the tools
:::

## Install R

R is distributed by [CRAN](https://cloud.r-project.org/) — the Comprehensive R Archive Network.

:::: {.columns .install-r-columns}

::: {.column width="62%"}
::: {.step-list .step-list-spaced}
1. Go to [cloud.r-project.org](https://cloud.r-project.org/)
2. Pick your OS — **Linux**, **macOS**, or **Windows**
3. On the Windows page click **base** 
4. Run the installer with the OS defaults
:::
:::

::: {.column width="38%"}
```{=html}
<img class="install-r-logo" src="https://www.r-project.org/logo/Rlogo.svg" alt="R project logo">
```
:::

::::

::: {.dh-note}
Any current **R 4.x** works — new versions ship in **April** and **October** each year.
:::

## Install RStudio

RStudio is the IDE (Integrated Development Environment) for R.

:::: {.columns .install-rstudio-columns}

::: {.column width="62%"}
::: {.step-list .step-list-spaced}
1. Go to [posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop](https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/)
2. Pick the free **RStudio Desktop** edition
3. Install with your OS defaults
4. RStudio auto-detects your R install
:::
:::

::: {.column width="38%"}
```{=html}
<img class="install-rstudio-logo" src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rstudio/hex-stickers/main/PNG/RStudio.png" alt="RStudio hex logo">
```
:::

::::

::: {.dh-note}
New versions ship every few months. RStudio prompts you on launch when one is available.
:::

## Alternative: Posit Cloud

Prefer nothing-to-install? [posit.cloud](https://posit.cloud/) runs RStudio in your browser.

:::: {.columns .install-posit-columns}

::: {.column width="62%"}
::: {.step-list .step-list-spaced}
1. Go to [posit.cloud](https://posit.cloud/)
2. Sign in with any email (Google / GitHub / plain)
3. Pick the **free** tier 
4. **15 projects**, **1 GB RAM**, and **1 CPU core** 
:::
:::

::: {.column width="38%"}
```{=html}
<img class="install-posit-logo" src="https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/7a/Posit_logo.svg" alt="Posit logo">
```
:::

::::

::: {.dh-note}
Runs on Linux under the hood — same OS-level surface as RStudio Desktop.
:::
